name: Opicapone
summary: Opicapone, sold under the brand name Ongentys, is a medication which is administered together with levodopa in people with Parkinson's disease. Opicapone is a catechol-O-methyltransferase (COMT) inhibitor.

pharmacology.text: Opicapone is a catechol-O-methyltransferase (COMT) inhibitor. It enhances the effects of levodopa, a precursor of the neurotransmitter dopamine that can be taken by mouth. Opicapone blocks an enzyme that breaks down levodopa in the body called catechol-O-methyltransferase (COMT).

body.says: Mainly sulfation, also reduction, glucuronidation, methylation

uses.text: In the EU, opicapone is indicated as adjunctive therapy to preparations of levodopa/ DOPA decarboxylase inhibitors (DDCI) in adults with Parkinson's disease and end-of-dose motor fluctuations who cannot be stabilised on those combinations.

sideEffects.text: The most common side effects are dyskinesia (difficulty controlling movement), constipation, increased blood creatine kinase, hypotension/syncope, and decreased weight.
